traceability.notes: Story 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING requires that all traceability-related ESLint rules emit clear, specific, and consistent error messages that identify the problem, location, and suggested fix, while handling edge cases gracefully. The core rules (require-story-annotation, require-req-annotation, require-branch-annotation, valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, and valid-req-reference) each define meta.messages that use the specified placeholders (e.g., {{functionName}}, {{missing}}, {{details}}, {{path}}, {{reqId}}, {{storyPath}}) and are annotated in code with @story docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md and the corresponding REQ-ERROR-* IDs. Their implementations call context.report with appropriate messageIds and data, and provide ESLint suggestions where required (notably for missing @story). Multiple Jest test suites explicitly tied to this story verify that, for a wide range of scenarios, the correct messageId and data are produced and that configuration and filesystem error conditions are reported via dedicated diagnostics instead of throwing. Given this direct code and test evidence, all acceptance criteria and requirements in the 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING story are fully implemented and verified.
